bioBn:
Forhad Hossain Azad is the State Minister for Water Resources and the member of parliament for Panchagarh-2. He took office on 17 February 2026. Azad, the BNP's rural development affairs secretary, has been elected to Parliament for the first time, in the 13th Parliament.

He was born on 12 March 1966 in Menagram, in Panchpir union of Boda upazila, Panchagarh; his father is Md. Tozammel Hossain. After taking a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Dhaka, he went abroad for higher education and pursued specialised studies in international relations and development economics.

He entered politics in 1991. He has served as the BNP's central rural development affairs secretary and as member secretary of the Panchagarh district BNP. After winning the Panchagarh-2 seat with the sheaf of paddy symbol in the 2026 election, he joined Tarique Rahman's Cabinet. He is the father of one son.
leadBn: Forhad Hossain Azad is a member of the 13th Parliament elected from Panchagarh-2, Secretary for Rural Development of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party and currently State Minister in the Ministry of Water Resources.
